raw.title: Investigation of Session Hijacking via Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Vulnerability (CVE-2023-4966)
raw.text: Citrix released a bulletin on 10 October 2023 for CVE-2023-4966 in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway. Mandiant saw zero-day exploitation from late August 2023. A GET request to /oauth/idp/.well-known/openid-configuration with an oversized HTTP Host header makes the appliance return memory contents, which can include a valid AAA session cookie. Session takeover bypasses passwords and multi-factor authentication. The web server on the appliance does not record requests to this endpoint, so evidence comes only from a WAF or other device that logs HTTP requests to the appliance.
